audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 4 disagreed with the packet chart, with the mirror, and with the whys on the same page.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Volibear x4, Skill, Yone, Yone]; the mirror set rows 1-3 to Volibear as one atomic group, and whys[1], whys[2], whys[3] all describe him winning while whys[4] says level 6 is skill-decided.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 3 -> Volibear (4/10, 3/10, 4/10), row 4 -> Skill (5/10), each as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase gave no cost for Stormbringer, so 'reassess the all-in' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Stormbringer is 160/135/110s and disables your tower on landing — the punish window after it is enormous.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten with the 160s figure and the tower disable; phases[2].why and phases[3].why now name Frenzied Maul's 5s cadence and Thundering Smash's 12s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was written as 'His engage. Bait it.' with no cooldown and no statement that the stun requires the completed run-up; the auto-reset tell and Frenzied Maul's on-hit application were absent.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, stuns the first enemy he attacks and resets that attack; Frenzied Maul is 5s, applies on-hit effects and heals him on the second cast; Sky Splitter is 16s and shields him when he stands in the blast.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the timers, the run-up condition, the reset tell, and the Sky Splitter shield.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s heal and applies on-hit, so he wins every extended trade at 3. Farm at range and wait for your item.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His power peaks at 4-5: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 and stuns only if he finishes the run-up. Break the line and farm safe.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1 and disables your tower — survive the leap and the next two minutes are yours to trade in.

edits.before: His engage. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 12s at rank 1, and the stun needs his run-up. Break the line.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s heal that applies on-hit — Executioner's Calling first back.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The Q wind-up resets his auto — step off the line as he starts it, not as it lands.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Thundering Smash (Q): 12s at rank 1 — the stun needs his run-up, so break the straight line. - Sky Splitter (E): 16s, and it shields him if he stands in it. - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1.

notes: Restated from the mirror: Volibear's Q stuns (it is not a slow — Sky Splitter and Stormbringer are the slows), and Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward Yone rather than knocking up. spikes[3].text and breakdown.late on this page still call Fate Sealed a knock-up; left unedited this pass because the same phrasing is templated across many yone matchups and should be fixed champion-wide, not one file at a time.
